images: to confirm: the cephalogram folder's glob inside the unpacked Aariz.zip, such as **/Cephalograms/*.png
format: to confirm: png or jpg, as the unpacked folder shows

person.regex: to confirm: one film is one person, since the record states no patient id, as (?P<case>[^/]+)\.(png|jpe?g)$

notes: 1,000 lateral cephalograms from seven devices (Khalid, Fraz et al., Scientific Data 2025), C2 to C4 in every film with the CVM stage; 29 landmarks and the stage are not vertebra boxes, so no label enters until a recipe maps the cervical landmarks to bodies; the device per film, if the zip lists it, goes into the device fields in a later change
